description: This file defines the VertexAIFilesHandler class for managing file operations in Google Cloud Storage via Vertex AI. It includes methods for creating files, extracting bucket and object info from file IDs, and downloading file content, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous workflows.

classes.name: VertexAIFilesHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing files in Vertex AI via GCS, supporting async and sync operations, including file creation and content retrieval.
